claim: public.pos_item_sales (migration cost_of_goods_reads_what_sold, ADR 0298 decision 8) reads qty, price and inventory_id at the top level of each pos_checks line. The line builder in apps/api-gateway/src/pos-hub/pos-hub.service.ts (the check.items.map block) writes qty: it.qty, price: it.price and inventory_id: mapped.inventoryId, each checked on its own line. A rename or a dropped key fails the build here, before every line reads as unmapped.
verify: b="$(awk '/const items = check\.items\.map\(/{on=1} on{print} on && /^[[:space:]]*\}\);/{exit}' apps/api-gateway/src/pos-hub/pos-hub.service.ts)"; test -n "$b" || exit 1; for k in 'qty: it\.qty' 'price: it\.price' 'inventory_id: mapped\.inventoryId'; do printf '%s\n' "$b" | grep -qE "^[[:space:]]*$k,\$" || exit 1; done
